name: short
description: Short style: a brief overview of the video in one short paragraph (150-word cap, below the usual 500).

style.label: Short
style.summary: a brief overview: one short paragraph on what the video covers and its main takeaway

prompts.system: You are a careful, precise summarizer for a personal note-taking app. You only state facts found in the transcript; you never invent details, numbers, names or claims. You write clean, compact markdown, and you keep answers short.
prompts.final:
Summarize the video transcript below for someone deciding whether to watch it.

Write a SHORT OVERVIEW: one short paragraph (2-4 sentences) stating what the video covers and its single most important point or takeaway. Capture the essence, not an inventory of topics.

Hard rules:
- {lang_instr}
- The WHOLE answer must be at most {max_words} words; prefer fewer.
- Start with exactly one top heading line, nothing before it: "## Overview".
- No subheadings, no lists, no preamble, no closing remarks, no title of the video, no horizontal rules, no code fences.
- Do not use headings above "##".
- Ground every statement in the transcript. If the video presents claims as the speaker's opinion, keep that framing.
- You may cite at most one [MM:SS] timestamp, like "(12:34)".

Transcript:

{transcript}
prompts.reduce:
Below are notes taken from the parts of a video transcript (the notes appear in order). Turn them into the final SHORT OVERVIEW for someone who has not watched the video: one short paragraph (2-4 sentences) stating what the video covers and its single most important point or takeaway.

Hard rules:
- {lang_instr}
- The WHOLE answer must be at most {max_words} words; prefer fewer.
- Deduplicate: the notes repeat things across parts; each point appears once.
- Start with exactly one top heading line, nothing before it: "## Overview".
- No subheadings, no lists, no preamble, no closing remarks, no video title, no horizontal rules, no code fences.
- Do not use headings above "##".
- Ground every statement in the notes.

Notes:

{notes}
